title: E. coli urosepsis, discharged to SNF, complete record in natural clinical prose (summary + nursing + case management)

rationale.pac_list: Case manager printed every Medicare-certified SNF within 10 miles (seven) and walked the patient and daughter through it.
rationale.pac_choice: Note says the decision is theirs, any facility on the sheet, and the facility they chose was used.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Care Compare star ratings, inspections, staffing and short-stay quality measures were reviewed with them.
rationale.hospital_course: Narrative under 'Why she was here and what happened' describes treatment and recovery.
rationale.discharge_condition: 'Her state today: stable and back to herself' with mental status and mobility.
rationale.disposition: 'Where she is going: Fairhaven Gardens, a skilled nursing facility (SNF)'.
rationale.pending_results: 'Results not yet back: none. All cultures are final.'
rationale.dp_evaluation: Summary refers to the case management assessment of post-hospital needs, which the CM note documents in full (needs, supports, availability).
rationale.dp_discussed: Plan explained to the patient and daughter, who agreed (summary and CM note).
rationale.info_transmitted: Summary and medication list faxed to the SNF and sent to the PCP on the discharge date.
